text: そこで　おまえ　たちには　わしの　かわりに　ゆめを　はたして　ほしいのじゃ！

structure.jp: ゆめを　はたして　ほしいのじゃ！
structure.en: I want you to fulfil the dream

patterns.name: 〜てほしい
patterns.explanation: て-form plus ほしい says you want someone else to do something. はたして　ほしい = 'I want you to fulfil'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ explains or stresses a reason or feeling; じゃ is the old-man form of だ. ほしいのじゃ = 'it's that I want it'.

patterns.name: 〜に (for someone)
patterns.explanation: 〜のかわりに means 'in place of'. わしの　かわりに = 'in my place'.
